variants.name: 100 g
variants.about_this_item:
Beaphar Duo Active is a two-colour paste, a complementary food for cats that supplies vitamins, minerals and other essential nutrients.

  • Taurine supports proper heart function and good eyesight.
  • The yellow paste supports healthy skin, a beautiful coat and strong immunity; omega-6 fatty acids help blood formation and resistance to infection.
  • The brown paste with BIO-MOS supports a healthy intestinal flora.
  • 0% added sugar.
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: Oils and fats, milk and milk products, derivatives of vegetable origin (malt extract 3.8%, MOS 4,700 mg/kg), yeasts, minerals, cereals.

Nutritional additives per kg: vitamin B1 370 mg, vitamin B2 110 mg, vitamin B6 110 mg, vitamin B12 780 µg, calcium D-pantothenate 110 mg, nicotinamide 995 mg, biotin 2,700 µg, taurine 4,400 mg, vitamin E 160 IU, folic acid 24 mg, antioxidants.

Analytical constituents: crude protein 16%, crude fibre 0.05%, crude oils and fats 53%, omega-3 3.129%, omega-6 24.15%, crude ash 4.2%, moisture 2.1%, calcium 0.54%, phosphorus 0.45%, sodium 0.4%, potassium 0.68%, magnesium 0.046%.
variants.feeding_instructions: Daily dose: 3 cm of paste. Mix with food or give directly from the tube. In serious cases double the dose. Make sure fresh drinking water is available.
